stem.text: The enthalpy changes of formation, $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{f}}$, of both $\text{PCl}_3$ and $\text{PCl}_5$ are exothermic.
Which pair of statements is correct?

A.text: $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ is less negative than $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{f}}$ ($\text{PCl}_5$).; The $\text{Cl}_2$ bond energy is needed in calculating $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ from enthalpies of formation.

B.text: $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ is more negative than $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{f}}$ ($\text{PCl}_5$).; The $\text{Cl}_2$ bond energy is needed in calculating $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ from enthalpies of formation.

C.text: $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ is less negative than $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{f}}$ ($\text{PCl}_5$).; The $\text{Cl}_2$ bond energy is not needed in calculating $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ from enthalpies of formation.

D.text: $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ is more negative than $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{f}}$ ($\text{PCl}_5$).; The $\text{Cl}_2$ bond energy is not needed in calculating $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ from enthalpies of formation.

A:
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ is less negative than
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{f}}$ ($\text{PCl}_5$).

The $\text{Cl}_2$ bond energy is needed in calculating
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ from enthalpies of formation.
B:
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ is more negative than
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{f}}$ ($\text{PCl}_5$).

The $\text{Cl}_2$ bond energy is needed in calculating
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ from enthalpies of formation.
C:
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ is less negative than
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{f}}$ ($\text{PCl}_5$).

The $\text{Cl}_2$ bond energy is not needed in calculating
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ from enthalpies of formation.
D:
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ is more negative than
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{f}}$ ($\text{PCl}_5$).

The $\text{Cl}_2$ bond energy is not needed in calculating
$\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{reaction}}$ from enthalpies of formation.
